newsitem.title: USA: Group Technologies names Lovelock president.
newsitem.headline: Group Technologies names Lovelock president.

text.p: Group Technologies Corp said on Thursday that it named Thomas Lovelock president and chief executive officer.
Lovelock replaces Robert Gill who served on an interim basis since November 1996.
Gill, who will remain director, served as chairman of the board from 1989 to 1992.
Before joining Group Technologies, Lovelock served as president and chief executive officer since 1993 of Bell Technologies Inc, an Orlando-based provider of electronic products.
Group Technologies, based in Tampa, provides advanced manufacturing, engineering and testing services to manufacturers of electronic products.
